class Animal {
  name = "animal";
  static kind = "mammal";
  constructor(public legs: number) {}
  speak(): string {
    return `${this.name} makes a sound`;
  }
  get label(): string {
    return `[${this.name}]`;
  }
  set label(value: string) {
    this.name = value;
  }
  static describe(): string {
    return `kind: ${this.kind}`;
  }
}

class Dog extends Animal {
  static kind = "dog";
  speak(): string {
    return `${super.speak()} (woof)`;
  }
  rename(value: string): string {
    super.label = value;
    return super.label;
  }
  static describe(): string {
    return `${super.describe()} / base ${super.kind}`;
  }
  legCount(): number {
    return super.legs;
  }
}

const dog = new Dog(4);
console.log(dog.speak());
console.log(dog.rename("rex"));
console.log(Dog.describe());
console.log(dog.legCount());
